# Tookio Solutions — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & System Architecture

## 1. Company Profile
Tookio Solutions is an enterprise ERP engineering consultancy based in Nairobi, Kenya. We design, implement, and support production-ready enterprise resource planning systems built on the Frappe Framework and ERPNext.

### Geographic Reach
Kenya (Headquarters), Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, and the greater East African Community (EAC).

## 2. Core Operational Modules

### A. Manufacturing & Production Execution
- Multi-tier Bill of Materials (BOM) with nested sub-assemblies and scrap percentages.
- Work Order scheduling against production capacity and machine bottlenecks.
- Shop floor terminal interfaces for real-time operator work logging and material consumption.
- Automated variance analysis comparing planned BOM costs versus actual production costs.

### B. Warehouse Management & Stock Ledger
- Perpetual inventory tracking using Moving Average or FIFO valuation.
- Multi-location warehouse hierarchy (Raw Materials, WIP, Finished Goods, Transit, Quarantine).
- Automated batch number management with expiration date tracking.
- Barcode and QR code scanning for receipt, transfer, pick, pack, and ship operations.

### C. Financial Governance & KRA eTIMS V2
- Automated electronic tax invoice transmission directly to Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) eTIMS V2.
- Localized tax compliance including 16% standard VAT, 0% export VAT, exempt items, and withholding VAT/tax.
- Multi-currency transactions with automated exchange rate updates and realized/unrealized gain/loss calculation.
- Automated bank reconciliation and direct M-Pesa business integrations (Paybill and Buy Goods).

### D. Procurement & Landed Cost
- Reorder level automation calculating purchase recommendations based on minimum stock and lead times.
- Request for Quotation (RFQ) supplier portals with automated side-by-side bid analysis.
- Landed Cost Vouchers calculating freight, marine insurance, and customs import duty allocated across items.

---

## 3. Supported Industry Verticals

### Plastics & Polymer Manufacturing
Extrusion, injection molding, and blow molding workflows. Cycle time tracking, regrind and masterbatch ratios, machine hour rates, and mold asset tracking.

### Food & Beverage (FMCG)
Batch recipe formulation, shelf-life and expiry date tracking, hygiene and QA checkpoints, delivery fleet dispatch, and trade promotions.

### Metal Fabrication & Heavy Engineering
Custom job-shop fabrication, cutting optimization, steel profile yield management, welding consumable tracking, and project-based progress billing.

### Wholesale & Distribution Logistics
High-volume multi-warehouse order fulfillment, route planning, salesperson mobile ordering, credit limit enforcement, and automated invoicing.

### Chemicals & Process Manufacturing
Density/concentration conversions, hazardous material compliance, batch blending records, and quality certificate generation.
